proposals.evidence: Full ṣaṣ separates section 2 *ṣuvaṭ from the simple ṣaṣ and affricate *kṣaṭ branches. The selected northwestern śo/śvā forms match Turner’s specific Maiya šōh/ṣō, Gawri ṣō, Bashkarik ṣɔ and Kohistani Shina ṣvā comparanda in section 2. Their rounded vowel or labial glide selects this branch; plain śe/ṣa is not included.
